free_tier.stated: EUR 3.16 per month on a 12-month term (EUR 37.90 for the year) for Linux VPS S: 1 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 25 GB NVMe, in Warsaw or Stockholm on AMD EPYC 7003 with DDR4 and a 2 Gbit/s port. The plan cards print yearly-billed rates: EUR 1.70 for XS (1 vCPU / 1 GB / 10 GB NVMe), EUR 2.87 for S, EUR 5.39 for M (2 vCPU / 4 GB / 50 GB) and EUR 9.89 for L (4 vCPU / 8 GB / 100 GB), each 'when pay yearly'; Warsaw costs 10 percent more, which puts S at 12 months in Warsaw at EUR 3.16. Terms run 1, 6, 12 and 24 months with 0, 5, 10 and 15 percent off; the 1-month rate is computed in JavaScript and is not printed in the server-rendered page.

egress.terms: unlimited, with a per-plan high-speed allowance on a 2 Gbit/s port and 10 Mbps after it: 1 TB on XS, 2 TB on S, 4 TB on M and 6 TB on L
